# **Gaps — no SOP yet**

- **Member Onboarding** – no structured first-touch, goal-setting, or induction pathway; critical for retention signal at day 1
- **Member Checkins** – no cadence or framework for progress tracking; coaching relationships drift without this
- **Cancellation & Churn** – no win-back protocol, exit interview, or pause-vs-cancel decision tree; lost revenue left on table
- **Coaching Development Roadmap** – no progression clarity for coaches; impacts retention and class quality consistency
- **Class Quality Audit Checklist** – no standardised way to measure coaching delivery against brand promise
- **Member data privacy & GDPR** – high-risk gap; compliance exposure and data handling undefined
- **Transformation Pillars** – no documented framework for member outcomes messaging (nutrition, strength, mindset, etc.); marketing and coaching misaligned
- **Referral Programme** – no mechanics, incentive structure, or tracking; word-of-mouth left unstructured
- **Weekly Key Coach Tasks** – no accountability framework for non-teaching work (admin, mentoring, retention outreach)
- **Troubleshooting Guide** – no escalation path for member complaints, billing disputes, or incident resolution
- **30 Day Goals & Member Outcomes** – no standardised check-in framework or outcomes capture for retention/upsell

# Service Menu Execution for The Forge

**Get it done in 2 sprints:**

• **Sprint 1 (This week):** Audit what you're *actually* delivering now. Have each coach log what they do daily for 3 days. You'll find inconsistencies and upsells you didn't know existed. This is your raw material—not assumptions.

• **Sprint 2 (Next week):** Build two separate docs. **Coaches' version** = decision tree (if member wants X, they get Y + Z). **Members' version** = simple pricing ladder (Basic: group classes only / Mid: + 2 PT sessions/month / Premium: unlimited PT + nutrition). Make pricing visible—mystery pricing kills conversion.

• **Specificity win:** Don't list "strength training" — list actual outcomes ("Build lean muscle in 12 weeks" + what's included). Members buy results, not features. Coaches need to know what they can *promise* without checking with you first.

• **Quick implementation:** Share coaches' version in your team WhatsApp/Slack. Send members' version to everyone who enquires within 24 hours. Track which tier gets clicked most—that's your conversion goldmine.

**One hard truth:** If you can't explain it in one page per audience, it's not clear enough. Rewrite until a new member and new coach both "get it" instantly.
